rules.label: Expiry-day extra ELM
rules.text: Extra 2% of notional as extreme-loss margin on short index options expiring that day (positions open at the start of the day and opened during it).

rules.label: Calendar-spread offset on expiry day
rules.text: No calendar-spread margin benefit for legs expiring that day; a hedge in a later expiry is margined as if separate.

rules.label: Upfront premium
rules.text: Option buyers pay the full premium upfront; no intraday leverage on long legs. Buy the wing first, then sell the short, to get the hedge benefit.

rules.label: Position limits
rules.text: Index-option position limits are also monitored intraday (at least four snapshots a day). Entity limits are far above this desk's size; not binding.

rules.label: Minimum contract value
rules.text: Rs 15 lakh at introduction; lots reviewed so a contract is worth Rs 15-20 lakh on review day.

rules.label: Base ELM
rules.text: Exposure margin of 2% of notional on short index options (5% beyond 9 months).

example.name: Sell an iron condor
example.assumptions: Early exit: every leg bought or sold back at 50% of its entry price (the playbook's profit-take); slippage half the stored bid-ask, else 3% of price. Held: all four legs expire out of the money, so there are no exit orders and no exercise STT.
